annotation_policy: Source P classes only; no P-value recomputation or invented correction
intentional_differences: The selected original panel letter c is omitted for an individual manuscript panel.
Final 92 × 66 mm canvas, Arial and 8 pt for every text role are explicitly adopted; source font points were not recovered.
Visible numeric segments are explicitly adopted as 0–16 and 35–84 to retain every point and comparison line; the reference's upper lower bound is inferred.
Deterministic bounded within-bar offsets preserve all five observations without claiming scientific x coordinates or mouse pairing.
Group colors come from direct PDF vector colors, not an exact color inference from the raster.
Full lower/upper SEM endpoints are displayed and checked; the reference visibly emphasizes the upper whisker.
Comparison guides may use the physical axis gap; no observation or SEM endpoint is hidden there.
evidence_limits: Engineering fixture only: simulated values/classes are not biological findings or evidence of statistical validity.
